_doc: Road paint on the Denver Grand Prix lap corridor (PLAN 4b), read off DRCOG's 3-inch aerials of 2022, 2020 and 2018 by paint_tile.py and assembled by paint_lap.py. Positions are lon / lat as the 2022 picture's georeference gives them (EPSG:2232 inferred; no registration shift applied; the older years are moved onto 2022 by the per-tile shift measured from their paint). The state surveyed is 2022's (PLAN D8). Every item is a mark a picture shows, except crosswalk bars flagged inferred. grade: measured / detected as SURVEY.md defines them; nothing is tagged or invented. See SURVEY.md.

sources.aerials: https://drapparchive.s3.amazonaws.com/<year>/<tile>.tif, years 2022, 2020, 2018, 0.25 ft pixels, read by HTTP range (lap_fetch.py)
sources.lidar: USGS 3DEP CO_DRCOG_2_2020 (EPT), flown 2020-05-27: the intensity check only

unsurveyed.what: Stout St under the Colorado Convention Center
unsurveyed.why: covered (OSM tunnel=building_passage): no aerial sees the road; nothing is filled in

colfax.note: PLAN D8: the last state a survey saw finished. OSM's present tags on the lap's Colfax ways are below: changed since, NOT surveyed; no paint is guessed from them.

per_leg.leg: Kalamath NB branch to Speer SB
